financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants, closed July 2023
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Company estimates that the net proceeds from the Offering will be approximately $22.9 million, after deducting placement agent fees and paying estimated offering expenses.

warrants.quote: the Company had outstanding warrant liabilities related to the 2022 private placement that allow the holders to purchase 7,609,879 shares of common stock at a weighted average exercise price of $4.75 per share.
As of March 31, 2023, there were 1,788,000 post-split stock purchase warrants outstanding. These stock purchase warrants expire on December 21, 2026.
Pre-funded warrants to purchase 2,919,140 Shares of Common Stock
